Scenario fixture: text-spacing-content-loss (WCAG 1.4.12)

Each target has a stable id of the form tscl_case_NN. The rule applies line height 1.5, 2em after paragraphs, letter spacing 0.12em and word spacing 0.16em, then measures the text. Cases 01 and 02 need a layout, so in jsdom they report nothing: their data-outcome-text-spacing-content-loss attribute gives that jsdom verdict, and the browser test checks the one in the title.

01 — FAIL: in a browser, a one-line box with overflow: hidden cuts off the line the spacing pushes down

02 — CANTTELL: in a browser, a one-line box lets the pushed-down line overlap the text below
